story.iWant: calculate recommended bet sizes based on edge and bankroll
story.soThat: the user doesn't overbets marginal picks
story.tasks:
- Task 1: Review architecture and requirements (AC: #1-#4) - Understand stake formula from Story 5.4 completion notes - Review bankroll parameter usage across pipeline - Verify unit sizing standard (1 unit = bankroll / 200) - Confirm input/output contracts with edge detection pipeline - Review Story 6.1 section in technical spec (section 5: Stake Sizing)
- Task 2: Implement stake_calculator module (AC: #1-#7) - Create `/src/bet_bot/analysis/stakes/__init__.py` with module docstring - Create `/src/bet_bot/analysis/stakes/stake_calculator.py` with: - `calculate_stake(bankroll: float, ev_percentage: float, confidence: int) -> dict` function - Implement formula: `stake = bankroll × (EV_pct × 0.01 * 0.1) × (confidence / 100)` - Implement unit calculation: `units = stake / (bankroll / 200)` - Implement stake clamping: max stake = bankroll × 0.05 (5% risk per pick) - Return dict with: `{"suggested_stake": float, "stake_in_units": float, "bankroll_percentage": float}` - Add comprehensive docstring with examples - Export `calculate_stake` from `__init__.py`
- Task 3: Handle edge cases and validation (AC: #8) - Test with EV = 0% → stake should be 0 - Test with confidence = 0% → stake should be 0 or minimal - Test with small bankroll ($100, 5% EV, 80% confidence) → should calculate correctly - Test with large EV (20%) → clamp to max 5% - Validate inputs: bankroll > 0, ev_percentage >= 0, confidence in [0, 100] - Log warnings for edge cases (very small stake, confidence too low)
- Task 4: Implement logging and transparency (AC: #9) - Log calculation formula with all inputs: bankroll, EV%, confidence - Log intermediate results: calculated stake before clamping - Log final result: stake, units, % of bankroll - Log warnings if: - Stake is clamped (would exceed 5%) - Confidence < 50% (risky pick) - EV < 2% (minimal edge)
- Task 5: Create unit tests (AC: #1-#9) - Create `/tests/unit/test_stake_calculator.py` with 15+ test cases - Comprehensive test suites: TestBasicCalculation, TestUnitSizing, TestClamping, TestEdgeCases, TestInputValidation, TestBankrollPercentage - Achieve >= 90% code coverage on stake_calculator module
- Task 6: Create integration tests (AC: #1-#9) - Create `/tests/integration/test_stake_calculator_integration.py` with 8+ test cases - Test integration with Story 5.4 edge detection pipeline - Test multiple pick scenarios and data quality scenarios
- Task 7: Write module documentation (AC: #1-#9) - Module docstring explaining stake sizing purpose - Docstring for `calculate_stake()` with parameter descriptions, return value, formula explanation, notes, and usage examples - Link to technical spec section 5
- Task 8: Verify integration with edge detection (AC: #1-#9) - Story 5.4 already calls stake calculation in detect_edges() - Verify calculate_stake is called with correct Pick fields - Verify stake values are added to Pick objects - Test end-to-end: fixtures → edge detection → stakes calculated

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Create `/src/bet_bot/analysis/stakes/stake_calculator.py` module 2. Implement `calculate_stake()` function accepting: bankroll (float), ev_percentage (float), confidence (int) 3. Formula: `stake = bankroll × (EV_pct × 0.1) × (confidence / 100)` 4. Example: $1000 bankroll, 5% EV, 80% confidence = $4 stake 5. Calculate unit sizing: `1 unit = bankroll / 200` 6. Return: dict with `suggested_stake` ($, float) and `stake_in_units` (units, float) 7. Clamp stake: Never suggest > bankroll (max 5% of bankroll per pick) 8. Handle edge cases: 0% EV, 0% confidence, small bankroll ($100) 9. Log stake calculation details for transparency 10. Export `calculate_stake()` from `/src/bet_bot/analysis/stakes/__init__.py`

artifact.title: Story 6.1: Implement Stake Calculator
artifact.snippet: Purpose: Calculate recommended bet sizes to prevent overexposure. Formula: stake = bankroll × (EV_pct × 0.1) × (confidence / 100). Example: $1000 bankroll, 5% EV, 80% confidence = $4 stake. Conservative approach: Never stake > 5% of bankroll per pick.

artifact.title: Story 5.4: Create Edge Detection Pipeline
artifact.snippet: Story 5.4 already calculates recommended_stake in detect_edges(). Formula used: bankroll × (ev_percentage * 0.01 * 0.1) × (confidence / 100). This story refines and separates stake calculation into dedicated module.

artifact.title: Story 5.3: Implement Confidence Scoring Logic
artifact.snippet: Provides final_confidence score (0-100) that is used as input to stake calculation formula. Confidence scaling: high confidence = full stake, low confidence = reduced stake.

artifact.reason: Existing implementation of stake calculation inline in edge detection pipeline. This story refactors this function into a dedicated module. Formula reference: bankroll * (ev_percentage * 0.01 * 0.1) * (confidence / 100). Clamps to max 5% of bankroll.

constraint.description: Stake Formula: stake = bankroll × (EV_pct × 0.01 × 0.1) × (confidence / 100). CRITICAL: Must match existing implementation in Story 5.4 pipeline.py _calculate_recommended_stake() exactly to ensure consistency.
constraint.source: Story 6.1 Dev Notes, Technical Spec Section 5

constraint.description: Maximum stake per pick: 5% of bankroll. Never suggest stake > bankroll × 0.05. This is a safety measure to prevent overexposure on single picks.
Minimum stake: $0.01 (one cent). Ensure return statement includes max(stake, 0.01) to prevent zero or negative stakes.

Unit sizing standard: 1 unit = bankroll / 200. This is a professional sports betting standard allowing ~200 picks at full stake before bankruptcy. Stake in units calculation: stake_in_units = suggested_stake / (bankroll / 200).
constraint.source: Story 6.1 Dev Notes - Unit Sizing Standard

constraint.description: MUST validate inputs before calculation: bankroll > 0, ev_percentage >= 0, confidence in range [0, 100]. Raise ValueError for invalid inputs.

Log ALL stake calculations with: (1) formula with inputs, (2) intermediate stake before clamping, (3) final result with units and bankroll %. Log WARNINGS for: stakes clamped, confidence < 50%, EV < 2%. Follow project logging pattern (structured logging with extra context dict).
constraint.source: Story 6.1 Tasks #4, Project CLAUDE.md Logging standards

constraint.description: MUST return dict with keys: "suggested_stake" (float), "stake_in_units" (float), "bankroll_percentage" (float). Do NOT change return type to custom class or named tuple without updating Story 5.4 integration.
Create `/src/bet_bot/analysis/stakes/` directory as new module. Implementation in: `/src/bet_bot/analysis/stakes/stake_calculator.py`. Exports from: `/src/bet_bot/analysis/stakes/__init__.py`

Story 5.4's detect_edges() already calculates stakes inline. This story creates dedicated module BUT must NOT break Story 5.4. After implementation, Story 5.4 can optionally refactor to call the new calculate_stake() function (but this is NOT required by Story 6.1 acceptance criteria).
constraint.source: Story 6.1 Dev Notes - Learnings from Previous Story

constraint.description: MUST achieve >= 90% code coverage on stake_calculator module. Tests MUST include: basic calculation, unit sizing, clamping, edge cases (zero EV, zero confidence, small/large bankrolls), input validation, and integration with Pick objects from Story 5.4.

Follow project anti-AI-inconsistency enforcement rules: use Pydantic v2 for any validation models, use proper async/await patterns if needed, use structured logging with logger module (NOT print), validate inputs at boundaries, handle errors explicitly (no bare except clauses).

interface.name: calculate_stake
interface.signature: def calculate_stake(bankroll: float, ev_percentage: float, confidence: int) -> dict[str, float]
interface.description: Main exported function for stake calculation. Input: bankroll (float, > 0), ev_percentage (float, >= 0), confidence (int, 0-100). Output: dict with keys "suggested_stake", "stake_in_units", "bankroll_percentage".

contract.postcondition: Returns dict with three float values. suggested_stake in currency units, never exceeds 5% of bankroll. stake_in_units = suggested_stake / (bankroll / 200). bankroll_percentage = (suggested_stake / bankroll) * 100.

interface.name: Pick.recommended_stake
interface.signature: recommended_stake: float = Field(..., description="Suggested bet amount in currency units", gt=0.0)
interface.description: Pick model field populated by calculate_stake() output. Type: float, constraint: > 0. This field is read by display layer (Story 7.1) for formatting betting recommendations.

interface.name: detect_edges integration
interface.signature: detect_edges(fixtures: list[Fixture], bankroll: float = 1000.0) -> list[Pick] | str
interface.description: Edge detection pipeline that orchestrates stake calculation. Currently calls _calculate_recommended_stake() inline at lines 426-430. After Story 6.1, can optionally call refactored calculate_stake() function from stakes module.

integration.input: Receives bankroll parameter, ev_percentage and confidence from EVResult and ConfidenceScoreBreakdown
integration.output: Populates Pick objects with recommended_stake value
integration.required: calculate_stake must produce stakes using same formula as current _calculate_recommended_stake to avoid breaking Story 5.4

tests.standards: The project follows pytest conventions with fixtures and parametrized tests. Test files located in `/tests/unit/` and `/tests/integration/` directories. Tests use assert statements for validation. Test functions named `test_*`. Test classes named `Test*`. Fixtures defined at module/session level using @pytest.fixture decorator. Parametrized tests use @pytest.mark.parametrize. All tests should include docstrings explaining what is tested. Follow existing test patterns in `/tests/unit/test_ev_calculator.py` and `/tests/unit/test_confidence_scorer.py` for consistency. Use mock/patch only when necessary (avoid for pure functions like stake calculation). Target >= 90% code coverage measured with pytest-cov.

tests.ideas:
AC #1-4 (Basic formula and example): - test_calculate_stake_example_from_ac: $1000 bankroll, 5% EV, 80% confidence → $4 suggested_stake, 0.4 stake_in_units - test_calculate_stake_high_ev: $1000 bankroll, 10% EV, 90% confidence → verify formula step-by-step - test_formula_order_of_operations: Verify (EV × 0.01 × 0.1) is applied before (confidence / 100) multiplication
AC #5 (Unit sizing): - test_unit_size_calculation: 1 unit = bankroll / 200 for various bankroll sizes ($100, $500, $1000, $10000) - test_stake_in_units_matches_formula: stake_in_units = suggested_stake / (bankroll / 200) for various inputs
AC #6 (Return structure): - test_return_dict_keys: Result dict has exactly "suggested_stake", "stake_in_units", "bankroll_percentage" - test_return_types: All values are float type - test_bankroll_percentage_calculation: (suggested_stake / bankroll) * 100 is correct
AC #7 (Clamping): - test_clamp_high_ev_high_confidence: 20% EV, 95% confidence → clamp to 5% of bankroll max - test_clamp_50_percent_ev: 50% EV, 100% confidence → clamps appropriately - test_no_clamp_normal_case: 5% EV, 80% confidence → no clamping needed - test_clamp_message_in_logs: Verify DEBUG log when clamping occurs
AC #8 (Edge cases and validation): - test_zero_ev_zero_stake: EV = 0% → stake should be $0.01 (minimum) - test_zero_confidence_minimal_stake: Confidence = 0% → stake should be $0.01 (minimum) - test_small_bankroll_100: $100 bankroll, 5% EV, 80% confidence → $0.40 stake (correct calculation) - test_large_bankroll_100000: $100,000 bankroll → no overflow, calculations correct - test_invalid_bankroll_negative: Negative bankroll → raises ValueError - test_invalid_bankroll_zero: Zero bankroll → raises ValueError - test_invalid_ev_negative: Negative EV → raises ValueError - test_invalid_confidence_above_100: Confidence > 100 → raises ValueError - test_invalid_confidence_negative: Confidence < 0 → raises ValueError
AC #9 (Logging): - test_log_calculation_details: Verify logger.info/debug called with formula inputs - test_log_intermediate_stake: Log before clamping value is recorded - test_log_final_result: Log includes stake, units, bankroll % - test_log_warning_clamped: Warning logged when stake is clamped - test_log_warning_low_confidence: Warning logged when confidence < 50% - test_log_warning_low_ev: Warning logged when EV < 2%
Integration tests (Story 5.4 compatibility): - test_integration_with_pick_objects: Create stakes for Pick objects from edge detection pipeline - test_integration_multiple_picks: Calculate stakes for multiple picks independently - test_integration_total_exposure: Document behavior when multiple picks sum to > bankroll (should be independent calculations, not sum-checked) - test_integration_data_quality_scenarios: Fresh data (high confidence) → reasonable stakes; Stale data (low confidence) → minimal stakes
